_note: B2G intervention finance for HELIO Flow. Costs stored in USD; UI converts to local currency. Every value labelled per COMPASS_DATA_LEDGER. Numbers are defensible ballparks from official Singapore programmes — realistic, not audited estimates.

discount_rate_social.label: literature-derived
discount_rate_social.source: Public-sector social discount rate; UK Green Book 3.5%, ADB 6-9% Asia infra — 4% mid, shown in UI

district_budget_usd.label: speculative
district_budget_usd.source: Demo framing: ~S$2M district low-carbon infrastructure envelope

carbon_price_usd_per_t.label: policy pathway
carbon_price_usd_per_t.source: Carbon Pricing Act 2018, Third Schedule (verified): S$45/t for 2026 and every later year until amended. 2030+ values follow the government's S$50-80/t by 2030 intent (mid S$65) — policy pathway, not law. USD at 1.35 SGD/USD

_unit_costs_note: Refreshed from sourced Singapore unit-cost research (2021-2026). VERIFIED = official SG figure; PARTIAL = SG-inferred; INDICATIVE = proxy. SGD→USD at 1.35.

covered_walkway_per_km.label: literature-derived
covered_walkway_per_km.source: LTA Walk2Ride programme ~S$1.5M/km (S$300M/200km, 2018) ÷ 1.35. Official MOT per-km statement is higher (S$2.0-3.0M/km, 2021) — using the programme-average lower end. [PARTIAL]

cycle_lane_per_km.label: literature-derived
cycle_lane_per_km.source: LTA cycling network >S$1B for ~1,300km ≈ S$770k/km ÷ 1.35 [programme avg]; specific urban contracts run to S$3.42M/km (S$188.3M/55km, 2023) [PARTIAL]

solar_per_kwp.label: measured
solar_per_kwp.source: EMA 2025 rooftop-PV benchmark S$1,009/kWp (1,000 kWp industrial; official range S$1,000-1,600) ÷ 1.35 [VERIFIED]

battery_per_kwh.label: calibrated proxy
battery_per_kwh.source: BNEF 2025 all-in turnkey BESS ~US$117/kWh + distributed/small-scale premium → ~US$250/kWh [PARTIAL]

ev_ac_port.label: literature-derived
ev_ac_port.source: LTA ECCG 2025 worked examples S$5,500-10,500/charger all-in (mid S$8k) ÷ 1.35 [PARTIAL]

shade_trees_per_km.label: calibrated proxy
shade_trees_per_km.source: NParks tree cost S$250-300/tree × ~100 trees/km = S$25-30k/km planting; + establishment/soil-cell/civils → ~S$120k/km ÷ 1.35. (Report 10 NParks-based supports this lower figure vs the UK-proxy 185k.) [INDICATIVE]

electricity_tariff.label: measured
electricity_tariff.source: SP Group SG tariff ~S$0.29/kWh ÷ 1.35 — solar displaces grid purchase (real cash saving)

ev_cost_recovery.label: calibrated proxy
ev_cost_recovery.source: Net charging margin (fee − wholesale electricity) per kWh dispensed
